pages.text:
Tiger Safaris | Fishing & Safari Camp on the Lower Zambezi
Chirundu · Lower Zambezi · Zimbabwe
One of the most established camps on the lower Zambezi
Riverside chalets, legendary tiger fishing, sundowners at the bar and unforgettable celebrations — all on the banks of the Great Zambezi.
Book Your Stay Explore Fishing
Welcome to Tiger Safaris
A wild, welcoming escape on the water s edge
There s nothing quite like waking to a Great Zambezi sunrise, or unwinding as the sun stretches across the water at the end of the day. Our camp sits on the banks of the river in Chirundu, where established chalets, a warm bar and restaurant, and expert fishing guides come together for a truly memorable stay.
We proudly practise catch & release to preserve this magnificent fishery for generations to come.
Riverside stays
5 self-catering chalets & family units
Tiger fishing
Guided boats on the lower Zambezi
Bar & dining
Custom menus or self-cater
Facilities & Services
Everything you need, right on the river
Sit back, relax and let us take care of it all — from the family fishing trip to a 100-seater wedding, so you can enjoy what you came here for: the beauty of the Zambezi.
Accommodation
Five self-catering river chalets plus full-board and air-conditioned family units on the water’s edge.
Bar & Catering
A relaxed bar and restaurant with custom menus — or self-cater in your fully equipped chalet.
Fishing & Boat Hire
Chase the mighty tiger fish with experienced guides, river runners, sportsters and an Ali boat.
Weddings
Say “I do” under indigenous trees on lush green lawns with the Zambezi as your backdrop.
The Catch
Moments from the Zambezi
From trophy tigers to feisty bream and giant vundu — the memories our guests take home.
Guest Stories

The service is outstanding, the restaurant and food delicious and all the staff were so accommodating. We will definitely be back very soon. Stay With Us
Accommodation
Wake to a Great Zambezi sunrise and relax to the sun stretching across the water at the end of the day.
5 river chalets
Each sleeps up to 6 guests
Air-con units
Full-board & family options
Family unit
Three bedrooms, open-plan living
Self-Catering River Chalets
Our main camp is made up of five beautiful chalets set on the banks of the Zambezi River. Each is able to sleep up to six people and is equipped with everything you need, including a stove, a fridge with freezer, and full crockery and cutlery.
With our bar and kitchen, we can now cater for your every need — just bring yourself and get everything else here. Ice is available too!
Full-Board Chalet & Family Unit
We also have a two-bedroom en-suite chalet with no self-catering facilities — fully air-conditioned. Situated at the back near the swimming pool and water hole, Chalet 7 has two bedrooms, each with two single beds and a shower and toilet en suite.
More recently finished is our new air-conditioned family unit: three bedrooms with two beds in each, an open-plan kitchen and dining area, a bathroom with bath and shower, and a veranda with a braai area. It s become very popular, especially for those who prefer to escape the heat.
